subject.title: feat: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config

question: Should OpenClaw expose per-conversation inbound debounce as a WhatsApp-owned `groups`/`direct` configuration setting, or first establish the broader plugin debounce-policy API proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458?
rationale: Both open PRs solve the same user problem but create different durable public contracts; code review cannot safely choose the product and API boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the WhatsApp-owned config
options.body: Adopt this bounded channel-local setting, retain the documented precedence and account replacement semantics, and avoid introducing a generic plugin API until another channel demonstrates the need.

options.title: Choose the generic plugin policy first
options.body: Pause this PR and evaluate the plugin API as the canonical extension seam if multiple channels genuinely need per-message debounce policy.

options.title: Defer both contracts
options.body: Keep the canonical feature request open but do not merge either implementation until the desired cross-channel product scope is agreed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the WhatsApp-owned config
recommendation.body: Adopt this bounded channel-local setting, retain the documented precedence and account replacement semantics, and avoid introducing a generic plugin API until another channel demonstrates the need.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only concretely evidenced participant across both active implementation proposals and can provide the relevant contract context; maintainer sponsorship remains required for the decision.
